hook:
I deleted the search box.
Here is what replaced it:

beats.reason: "chicken burrito bowl with guac" is already a complete description, so the app treats it as one.

beats.claim: Or you hold the mic and say it
beats.reason: Speaking a meal out loud takes about four seconds and needs neither hand free afterwards.
No forms, nothing to search for — the point was to remove the part where you describe food twice.
